Title: Senior Data Scientist - Machine Learning
Description:
At Catawiki, every day brings the extraordinary! Whether it’s Daniel Ricciardo’s Formula 1 Car, a Woolly Mammoth’s Skeleton, Lady Gaga's Jumpsuit or Usain Bolt’s running shoe, we encounter exceptional objects every day.

We’re a one-of-a-kind marketplace for buying and selling special objects. Each week, more than 100,000 unique items are auctioned, all carefully curated by our passionate in-house experts.

Having sold over 25 million unique objects, our mission is to become the world’s most popular destination for special objects. As a growing, diverse and sustainable scale-up, we proudly live by three core values. If these values resonate with you, we’d love to explore how you can join us.


Taking ownership and driving impact
Being open to change and feedback
Being passionate about our mission and our customers.


Our Data Story

With Ten-thousands Of Active Items On Auction Every Day, Hundred-thousands Of Bids, Millions Of Users, And Billions Of Events, The Catawiki Platform Generates Vast Amounts Of Data. We Collect This Data Centrally, Using It To Generate Business Insights, As Well As Powering Machine Learning Models That Enhance Our User Experience, Optimize Our Workflows, And Keep Our Platform Safe. We Believe In Creating Flexible Models That Can Be Applied To a Variety Of Use Cases, And In Experimentation And Iteration To Hit The Ground Running And Continually Improve The Tools We Build.The Data Team, Which Covers The Full Data Spectrum Of Machine Learning, Analysis And Data Engineering, Has a Clear a Mission Within Catawiki

Why: We believe that by using data in a smart way, we can build the best Catawiki possible. We want to have impact and see opportunities everywhere.

How: We are builders, thinkers and talkers. We collaborate closely with every department to create value for our customers. We think big and hold ourselves to high standards, because our work really matters for the future of the company.

What: As a result we create business value by delivering scalable, robust models and actionable insights and predictions. We help the company to find opportunities and understand success, and we empower everyone to use data to be successful.

So What's The Job

As a Senior Machine Learning Data Scientist in the Data Team at Catawiki you will focus on delivering scalable and impactful data products. You’ll work closely with our product and development teams while implementing your work. This includes:


Building production-ready models that apply machine learning and advanced data science techniques within our product offering by writing robust and scalable code.
Finding data science opportunities by exploring our extensive mobile and web data, and applying machine learning and advanced statistics to tackle these real-world business problems.
Being pragmatic when needed but also able to go deep into a problem, applying your expert knowledge of machine learning techniques
Working with cross-disciplinary teams involving product owners, developers, UX designers, and business analysts in identifying improvements and new use cases for ML
Deploy scalable models using Kubernetes on cloud infrastructure, producing real-time, asynchronous, and batch predictions


Who You Are


You are an all-around data scientist with 5+ years of experience who is as comfortable diving into the internals of a model implementation as discussing new opportunities for ML with product stakeholders
Can use your broad skill set to solve challenging ML problems and have a high throughput.
Are familiar with a range of different ML techniques and use that to select a good solution for their projects.
Are able to considers the operating/deployment constraints of large models and implement solutions accordingly
Give guidance and unblock others in your team by supporting them with advice and new techniques.
Have a strong quantitative background (statistics, ML, sciences, etc.)
Are fluent in Python and capable with SQL
Have deployed ML models serving real time responses on a large scale
Have demonstrable experience in building robust data products that created value for the company you worked for.


The Following Are a Plus


Proven ability to extract meaning from very big datasets with little engineering support.
Experience with one or more of the following: PyTorch/Tensorflow, LightFM, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Google BigQuery, MySQL, Spark, Airflow, Kafka, nginx, CI/CD,
An entrepreneurial mindset that enables you to get things done, even if that requires actions outside your own area or comfort zone.


Where you'll be

This role is based in Lisbon. We work in a hybrid model with two days a week in the office.

Why You'll Love Working with Us


Create a visible impact by working at scale in a global organisation serving millions of customers across 80+ categories. In our flat structure, every role has a broad scope and directly impacts both our customers and the business.
Learn and grow through our Learning & Development initiatives, including clear development plans and mentorship programmes to support your career progression.
A culture of connection defines us. We’re a passionate, diverse team of 800+ Catawikians representing 60+ nationalities. We foster an inclusive and queer-friendly environment where everyone is encouraged to bring their full self to work.
Celebrate life’s moments with us. You’ll receive a €100 Catavoucher when you join, a €50 Catavoucher on your birthday, and an extra day off each year to “Pursue Your Passion”. We also offer additional leave for key work anniversaries and important life events. Benefits may vary by location.


Our Offices and Way of Working

Our vibrant offices in Amsterdam and Lisbon are designed to inspire collaboration. Most Catawikians operate in a hybrid setup, combining office-based and remote work, with a minimum of two days per week in the office, unless a role is explicitly stated as fully remote or fully office-based.

Interested?

Apply with an English CV and Cover Letter. By applying, you agree to Catawiki’s Applicant Privacy Policy. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Title: Senior Data Scientist — Berlin – Health Technology
Description:
Senior Data Scientist — Berlin – Health Technology




We are working with a Berlin based AI-native patient intelligence company, backed by leading European healthtech investors. Their platform captures something the life sciences industry has never been able to access at scale: the patient's own account of living with a chronic or rare condition.




About the role




This role puts you at the heart of how that data becomes intelligence.

Working closely with their Chief AI Officer, you'll take unstructured patient narratives, hundreds of data points per person, and turn them into the models, metrics, and evidence that our clients act on. The questions are genuinely open: how do you quantify a patient journey? What signals predict a treatment switch? Where does the data reveal unmet need no one has named yet?




It's a role with unusually short distance between analysis and impact. What you build ships into a live product, in front of global life science teams, and shapes decisions that reach patients with chronic conditions worldwide.




What you'll do




Analyze and model large, multi-modal patient datasets to surface insights on patient journeys and unmet needs
Partner with the Chief AI Officer to develop, validate, and scale the algorithms behind our Patient Journey Analytics Platform
Work with engineers and product managers to turn data insights into user-facing features
Design and implement pipelines for data cleaning, feature engineering, and predictive modeling
Communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, shaping how life science companies make decisions
Keep pace with state-of-the-art ML/AI methods and bring new ideas into our production stack




What you'll bring




3+ years' professional experience as a Data Scientist, ideally in healthtech, SaaS, or a related field
Strong Python (pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow or similar)
Strong SQL and experience with both structured and unstructured data
Solid grounding in statistical modeling, machine learning, and data visualization
Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Ability to run independently on complex problems while collaborating closely with product and engineering
Full professional fluency in English, written and spoken




If you are an experienced Data Scientist who wants to make a true impact with a positive mission, please get in touch.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Luxclusif is a technology-driven global B2B platform founded in 2013 and part of Farfetch since 2021. Dedicated to redefining the luxury paradigm by offering premium pre-owned fashion to a global audience, Luxclusif has pioneered the global luxury resale market, with advanced data-driven solutions to facilitate the buying and selling of high-end pre-owned items. With operations spread across the globe and strategic warehouses in key locations, ensure a seamless supply of luxury goods, ensuring item curation, quality control, operations, logistics to technology integrations and sales, delivering an unmatched resale experience for brands, retailers, and end-customers.

THE TEAM

Our R&D team is responsible for designing, developing, and evolving the internal products that power our business. As a B2B company specialising in second-hand luxury items, we rely on technology to optimise every stage of our operations, from buying and inbound logistics to selling and post-sales support. We are a global team with members across Portugal, Brazil, and the Philippines.

PORTO

Our office is near Porto, in the north of Portugal, and is located in a vibrant business hub. It offers a dynamic and welcoming environment where our employees can connect and network with a large community of tech professionals.

THE ROLE

As a Data Scientist you will be part of a multidisciplinary team within the Data cluster, responsible for the development of strategic data products to enable company competitiveness and analytical insights collaborating closer with the R&D Products line. We're looking for a team player that is passionate about tech products and is looking for eager opportunities to grow.

What You’ll Do


Collaboratively design, build, and maintain solutions within our platform using multiple tools applying statistical approaches and machine learning techniques
Working closely with our Engineers and Analysts in highly impactful and complex challenges. Design, Build and Expand our data products, taking them to the next level while using state-of-the-art technologies
Perform analysis and experiments that allow the team to identify opportunities and follow new implementations contributing directly to the evolution of our data products





Who You Are


You have a degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Machine Learning or equivalent specialized training/certification
You have at least 5 years of experience in the role or similar with proven experience on data science environments, building and architecture production-level data products
You’re capable to design, model, develop, test and maintain machine learning solutions and you have the experience to productize these solutions
You have experience in SQL and Python programming (familiar with TensorFlow and other machine learning libraries)
You’ve a strong sense of the data lifecycle and you’re obsessed with data quality
Proactive mindset regarding AI tools and solutions with high impact for the business and productivity
You are problem solving oriented and you’re also comfortable speaking English
Experience with CI/CD tools and cloud environments





Rewards & Benefits


Health insurance for the whole family, flexible working environment and well-being support and tools
Extra days off, sabbatical program and days for you to give back for the community
Training opportunities and free access to Udemy
Flexible benefits program

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Twoday is one of the leading digital transformation partners in Northern Europe with a global presence. With approximately 3,000 technologists, we collaborate with the most admired private and public organizations to deliver cutting-edge digital solutions. Our deep industry expertise includes Data & AI, software development, digital experiences, and business applications. Operating across the Nordics and Lithuania, our team serves over 8,000 customers and supporting their digital transformation journeys. 

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to join our AI team!

Most organizations have no shortage of ideas for what to model. Far fewer can turn a vaguely stated business problem into a well-posed prediction task, pick the algorithmic approach that fits it, and defend the result when someone asks how the number was produced. That gap is where you come in. You will do the analytical work that turns a customer's business problem into a model that holds up, and then into something they actually use, alongside data engineers, AI/ML engineers, cloud architects, and software developers on some of the largest Data & AI teams in the Nordics.

This is a hands-on role. You will spend most of your time in data and in code, with experienced colleagues around you and room to take ownership of the analyses and models you know best.

What are we looking for?

You are a scientist and a builder. Given a business problem stated in a customer's own words, you can work out what should be predicted, at what granularity, against which target, and what a good result would even look like. You are rigorous about how you validate a result, and you have learned that the hard part is rarely the algorithm itself.

We expect you to bring:


Hands-on data science experience, including at least one or two models you have taken past the prototype stage and to production.
Experience translating a business objective into a formal AI/ML problem: defining the target variable and unit of analysis, agreeing what success means with the people who will use the model, and saying early when the data will not support the question.
Strong predictive modelling craft: classification, regression, time series and generative AI
Judgement about algorithmic choice: when a well-specified baseline or classical statistical model is enough or when a heavier method earns its cost and when the problem is not a prediction problem at all.
Solid applied statistics: honest validation, uncertainty, and the ability to explain what a result does and does not support.
Strong software fundamentals to write code others can build on
Experience on Azure: Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric (Experience from AWS or GCP transfers, and we will not hold it against you.)
Experience applying generative AI where it genuinely fits, including RAG architectures and the evaluation of prompts and models.
An awareness of what governance means in practice: reproducibility, model documentation, GDPR, and bias and fairness considerations. You do not need to have all the answers, but you should know the questions matter.
The ability to present your work to a customer's stakeholders and explain what you did and why, without flattening the trade-offs into a slogan.
Fluent spoken and written Danish is a requirement.


Will your responsibilities be?


Deliver the analytical work in customer projects: exploration, feature work, baselines, modelling, validation, and documentation.
Take part in framing sessions with customers and help shape a business problem into a prediction task with a defined target, a defined decision it supports, and success criteria the business recognises.
Propose and justify the algorithmic approach for the problems you own, starting from a baseline and adding complexity only where it pays.
Build models that hold up in production, together with our AI/ML engineers, and help interpret how they behave once they are live.
Choose and defend evaluation metrics that reflect the business outcome rather than only the leaderboard.
Work closely with customers' analysts and domain experts through delivery and handover.
Share what you know: code reviews, internal sessions, and pairing with less experienced colleagues.
Grow towards a lead role over time if that is the direction you want. We will support it.


About you


You take ownership and are comfortable working in complex environments
You are pragmatic and focus on delivering real-world value
You enjoy working across disciplines and bridging gaps within teams


What can we offer?

twoday is located in modern offices in 30 locations in Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, and Lithuania. We have a strong and unique social environment with highly engaged employees. If you are the candidate we are looking for, you will have a central role with exciting opportunities to develop in an international and innovative group, with exciting products and services within technology and software. You will also have the flexibility to "jump" and work from one of our headquarters in Oslo, Stockholm, Copenhagen, Helsinki, or Vilnius at times.

Diversity & Inclusion

Are you not meeting all the requirements listed? Studies have shown that women and other minority groups are less likely to apply for a job if they don't meet every qualification. We're dedicated to build a workplace of diversity and inclusion. If you are excited about this role but your previous experience does not match the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
¡Hola! Somos OGA




Nos ilusiona que estés considerando esta oportunidad de empleo.




Somos una compañía pionera en la hibridación de la Inteligencia Artificial y la Investigación Operativa, con sede en Sevilla. Nuestro objetivo es transformar la industria a través de soluciones innovadoras y de alto impacto para nuestros clientes, líderes en sectores como el logístico, supply chain, industrial o el químico.




Esto lo conseguimos gracias al talento de nuestro equipo, que incluye a matemáticos/as, estadísticos/as o desarrolladores/as de software, entre otros, y a la confianza de grandes clientes. Además, mantenemos una estrecha colaboración con la Universidad a través de nuestro Consejo Asesor Tecnológico, Grupo CÁTEDRA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional, especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, y con el que reforzamos nuestra propuesta y valor científico.




Sobre la posición.




Buscamos un/a Senior Data Scientist con experiencia en la investigación, análisis y modelado de datos para identificar patrones y tendencias clave, impulsando la toma de decisiones estratégicas en la organización, para unirse a nuestro equipo.




¿Qué harás?





Análisis de datos y desarrollo de aplicaciones de optimización de procesos complejos con técnicas tanto de Inteligencia Artificial como de Investigación Operativa, utilizando entre otros, lenguajes de programación como Python, Java, JavaScript o C++.


Analizar, depurar, transformar, visualizar, etc. los datos disponibles para proyectos de IA, utilizando las herramientas y tecnologías necesarias en cada caso concreto.


Realizar el EDA (Exploratory Data Analysis) de los datos para proporcionar un buen conjunto de datos a los modelos de IA.


Utilización de diferentes modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning, los cuales serán entrenados, validados y testados en función de los objetivos de cada proyecto.


Tuning de modelos ML/DL.


Investigación e implementación de algoritmos y herramientas de ML/DL.


Implementación del pipeline completo de un modelo de ML/DL (Datasource, Limpieza datos, Ingeniería de Variables, Entrenamientos, Validación, Puesta en producción y Monitorización/Operación).


Analizarás bases de datos utilizando técnicas de análisis estadístico avanzado.


Desarrollarás soluciones y modelos avanzados de Inteligencia Artificial.


Elaborarás documentación técnica relacionada con los proyectos.









Timing de primeras semanas en OGA




Desde tu primer día, estarás acompañado/a por todo el equipo. El área de People organizará una serie de reuniones de Onboarding en tres niveles con distintos responsables de OGA: aspectos generales y sistemas internos, el propósito de la compañía y las tecnologías que utilizamos. También conocerás a tu Buddy, quien te guiará, especialmente en tu primer mes, durante todo el proceso de integración. Junto a tu Buddy, tendrás reuniones programadas para abordar cualquier tema que facilite tu adaptación.




¿Qué requerimos?





Titulación en Máster en Matemáticas / Estadística / Ingeniería / Ciencias de la Computación o área relacionada (valorable Doctorado).


Experiencia de más de 5 años en el sector de Inteligencia Artificial, incluyendo al menos 3 años como consultor senior liderando proyectos complejos y horizontales con exposición al negocio, con experiencia en tratamiento de datos (captura, almacenamiento, normalización, limpieza, visualización, ETLs y modelos de datos) e implementación de soluciones de IA utilizando Machine Learning y Deep Learning, aplicando algoritmos supervisados, no supervisados y auto-explicativos, como RandomForest, CatBoost, XGBoost, CNN y RNN.


Conocimiento y dominio experto en Python (valorable experiencia en otras plataformas y lenguajes), conocimientos recomendables en bases de datos como Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL y MS SQL/SQL Azure, así como experiencia en el entorno de desarrollo de Microsoft Azure. Nivel Alto de inglés.









¿Qué valoramos?





Airflow, Hadoop, Spark, MongoDB.


Interés por el desarrollo de una carrera técnica y vocación por la especiación tecnológica.


Pasión por la tecnología y por la creación de valor para el cliente.


Capacidad de relación con equipos de negocio y funcionales, visión holística del problema de negocio a resolver.


Orientación a resultados, proactividad, trabajo en equipo.


Disponibilidad para viajar a nivel nacional e internacional de manera esporádica.









¿Qué te ofrecemos?





Un entorno de trabajo dinámico y flexible, con proyectos y clientes tecnológicamente retadores en nuestra oficina de Sevilla.


Formar parte de un equipo apasionado por los datos y la innovación tecnológica, con perfiles senior y junior, de las áreas de las matemáticas, estadística, ciencia de datos o desarrollo de software, entre otras.


Colaboración permanente con el Grupo CÁTEDRA, el Consejo Asesor Tecnológico de OGA, compuesto por 14 catedráticos de renombre nacional e internacional especializados en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos.


Acceso a diversas herramientas de IA Generativa, que nos ayudan a acelerar tiempos de entrega, aumentar capacidad productiva, minimizar desgastes y sobrecargas, y en definitiva maximizar la eficiencia y rentabilidad de OGA.


Sesión de onboarding con responsables de OGA y de People, en la que te entregaremos tu kit de bienvenida.


Participación en eventos corporativos donde podrás conocer e interactuar con el resto del equipo de una forma distendida y divertida.


Asistencia al congreso anual del Grupo CÁTEDRA en Sevilla, donde se presentan los últimos avances y proyectos en Investigación Operativa y ciencia de datos, con una completa agenda científica, formativa y de debate.


Plan de formación continua. En OGA, la formación continua es un valor clave y un pilar de nuestro compromiso con el desarrollo personal y profesional. Nos inspiramos en el concepto de ikigai, buscando que cada persona encuentre aquello que le motive y le permita crecer dentro de la organización. Por eso, te propondremos acciones formativas que consideremos valiosas para tu crecimiento. Sin embargo, serás tú quien debe tomar la iniciativa en tu propio desarrollo, identificando aquello que te apasiona y proponiendo a tu responsable las formaciones que desees realizar. Juntos evaluareis su viabilidad, su aporte de valor y su alineación con la estrategia de OGA.


Compromiso con la inclusión y la diversidad. En OGA nos tomamos muy en serio el talento. Creemos que cada persona aporta algo único y especial, por lo que es parte de nuestro compromiso ofrecer un ambiente donde todos podáis brillar.


Beneficios sociales y profesionales integrados en un plan global de conciliación. Como ‘entidad familiarmente responsable’ - efr - desde 2015, certificada por la Fundación Másfamilia, en OGA hemos desarrollado un amplio catálogo de beneficios para tu bienestar personal y profesional.









¡Únete a nosotros!




Si te entusiasma nuestra visión innovadora y estás listo/a para enfrentar desafíos diarios con empresas líderes, ¡queremos conocerte! Aplica ahora y únete a OGA para seguir creando soluciones increíbles y de gran impacto.




Por supuesto, si durante el proceso de selección necesitaras algún tipo de asistencia, simplemente avísanos. Nuestro equipo de People te ayudará para asegurarnos de que todo vaya sobre ruedas y tengas una experiencia genial.




¡Te esperamos!

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
WHO WE ARE

At Macadam, we've built an app that rewards people for walking. With over 15 million users worldwide, we help individuals turn their daily steps into positive habits for health, wellbeing, and sustainability.

Our team is growing fast, and our ambitions are global. We operate at the intersection of health, gamification, and technology, and we're building a world-class data team to support this growth.

If you’re passionate about using data and machine learning to build products that improve lives at scale, we’d love to meet you.

Please submit your CV in English.




THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Data Scientist to help shape Macadam’s product and growth strategy through machine learning, experimentation, and advanced analytics.

You will work on high-impact topics such as personalization, user engagement, retention, monetization, fraud prevention, and reward economy optimization. This is a hands-on senior role with ownership from problem definition through deployment and impact measurement.

You will partner closely with Product, Growth, Marketing, Engineering, and Analytics teams to build data-driven solutions used by millions of users.

This role is based in Barcelona. We're looking for candidates who are already living in the city or ready to relocate.




RESPONSIBILITIES

Identify and lead data science opportunities that improve growth, engagement, retention, revenue, and user experience
Build machine learning models for personalization, recommendations, user behavior prediction, segmentation, and forecasting
Develop solutions supporting churn prevention, lifetime value optimization, fraud detection, and Macadam’s reward economy
Design and analyze experiments using A/B testing, causal inference, and other advanced statistical methods
Take models from initial exploration to production, working closely with Data and Engineering teams
Define clear success metrics and evaluate solutions based on measurable product and business impact
Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Contribute to Macadam’s data science roadmap, standards, and best practices




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

5+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Science, or a similar role
Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
Experience using BigQuery, GCP, dbt, and product analytics tools such as Mixpanel or Firebase Analytics
Experience developing, deploying, and evaluating machine learning models
Familiarity with data pipelines and production machine learning workflows
Strong knowledge of statistical modeling, experimentation, and model evaluation
Experience working with large behavioral, transactional, or product datasets
Strong product and business mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes
Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills
Fluent in English




NICE TO HAVE

Experience with consumer mobile apps, gaming, advertising, loyalty, or rewards products
Experience with recommender systems, personalization, churn, LTV, or fraud models
Experience with causal inference, uplift modeling, or large-scale experimentation
Familiarity with mobile attribution frameworks, including Apple’s SKAdNetwork




WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU

Be part of a mission-driven company making a tangible difference in people's lives, one step at a time.
Real ownership: lead high-impact data science initiatives and build solutions used by millions from day one.
Opportunities for professional growth, learning, and international exposure.
A supportive, talented, and passionate international team.
Offices in the heart of Barcelona.
Meal voucher.
Wellness allowance (powered by Urban Sports).
Private healthcare (Alan).
Hybrid working culture with international flexibility.
4 additional Macadam holiday days.
Friday team lunch.
Company events and offsites.




WHY MACADAM?

We don’t just talk about change - we walk it.

Our principles:

Make it happen - take ownership, drive outcomes that matter.
Build together, win together - support and challenge each other to go further.
Trust the data - decide clearly, act confidently, measure what counts.
Build for people - design with empathy, simplicity, real humans in mind.
Think bigger - set the bar high, push boundaries, imagine better ways.

Title: Data Scientist (H/F)
Description:
🚀 MP DATA recrute un(e) Data Scientist




Vous êtes passionné(e) par l'intelligence artificielle, le machine learning et les projets à fort impact ? Rejoignez MP DATA et participez au développement de solutions innovantes au service de nos clients.




Vos missions :




En tant que Data Scientist, vous serez amené(e) à :




Concevoir, développer et optimiser des modèles de Machine Learning, Deep Learning et de modélisation mathématique.
Réaliser les analyses exploratoires (EDA), le prétraitement des données, la sélection de variables et la validation statistique.
Mettre en place des expérimentations reproductibles et comparer différentes approches.
Tester, documenter et industrialiser vos modèles.
Collaborer avec les équipes Data Engineering, ML Engineering et les experts métier.
Présenter vos résultats et accompagner les utilisateurs dans la compréhension des modèles.
Participer à la veille technologique et contribuer au développement de notre expertise en IA.




Votre profil :




Diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieur (Centrale, Mines, INSA, ISAE, Supaero, etc.) ou équivalent.
Vous justifiez d'au moins 1 an d'expérience en Data Science.
Vous disposez de solides compétences en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques et apprentissage automatique.
Vous êtes curieux(se), autonome, rigoureux(se) et appréciez le travail en équipe.




Compétences techniques :




Python (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
Machine Learning & Deep Learning
XGBoost, LightGBM, Hugging Face (un plus)
Environnements Cloud : AWS, Azure ou GCP
Outils de datavisualisation : Plotly, Power BI, Streamlit
Méthodologies Agile




Les plus :




Intérêt pour le NLP, la Computer Vision ou l'IA générative.
Connaissance des secteurs industriel ou aéronautique.
Bonne maîtrise de l'anglais.




Processus de recrutement :




Échange téléphonique (5 à 10 minutes)
Premier entretien : présentation de votre parcours et de MP DATA
Test technique basé sur un cas d'usage concret
Deuxième entretien technique
Rencontre avec notre Directeur d'Agence dans nos locaux à Balma




Vous souhaitez évoluer sur des projets innovants au sein d'une équipe d'experts et contribuer à des réalisations concrètes en Data Science ?




Postulez dès maintenant ou contactez-nous pour en savoir plus.

Title: Data Science
Description:
¿Te gustaría trabajar en un proyecto internacional de inteligencia artificial y ciencia de datos, participando en el desarrollo y mejora de soluciones avanzadas de procesamiento de documentos mediante LLMs, NLP, RAG y Machine Learning?




En Capitole buscamos un/a Data Scientist especializado en NLP y Large Language Models (LLMs) para unirse a nuestro equipo en Barcelona. Serás responsable de diseñar soluciones avanzadas de procesamiento de lenguaje, construir infraestructuras RAG, desarrollar modelos predictivos y llevar tus modelos a producción junto a equipos de ingeniería y producto.




Tu trabajo tendrá impacto directo en decisiones estratégicas del grupo, transformando datos complejos en insights accionables y modelos robustos.




🧩 Responsabilidades principales

NLP & LLMs

Diseñar y construir arquitecturas RAG para mejorar el rendimiento de LLMs.
Desarrollar embeddings, modelos de clasificación, tokenización y pipelines NLP.
Trabajar con transformers (BERT, GPT, RoBERTa) y técnicas de fine‑tuning.
Aplicar prompt engineering y evaluación avanzada de modelos.




Data Science & Machine Learning

Construir modelos predictivos: regresión, árboles, redes neuronales, optimización, recomendadores y forecasting.
Evaluar, validar y optimizar modelos con metodologías rigurosas.
Realizar análisis exploratorio, detección de patrones y anomalías.




Infraestructura & Producción

Desarrollar soluciones en AWS y entornos cloud.
Implementar código de calidad: testing, CI/CD, GitHub, SonarQube.
Colaborar con equipos de producto para llevar modelos a producción.




Visualización & Comunicación

Crear dashboards y visualizaciones claras para stakeholders no técnicos.
Comunicar insights y resultados de forma estructurada y orientada a negocio.




Data Governance

Garantizar cumplimiento de GDPR y buenas prácticas de calidad de datos.




🎓 Requisitos

4–5+ años de experiencia en Data Science o roles similares.
Experiencia sólida en NLP, LLMs, transformers y modelos predictivos.
Python avanzado (Pandas, PyTorch, Modin, etc.).
Experiencia con AWS y despliegue de modelos.
Conocimientos de ETL, manipulación y limpieza de datos.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y storytelling técnico.
Inglés alto/fluido.




🏠 Modalidad híbrida en Barcelona (2 días de presencialidad en Viladecans, Barcelona)

📘 1.200€ anuales para formación y certificaciones.

🏥 Seguro médico privado.

🍽️ Retribución flexible (restaurante, transporte y guardería).

🏋️ Acceso a Wellhub con miles de gimnasios y actividades deportivas.

🎉 Eventos, team buildings y actividades de equipo.

🔧 Comunidades tecnológicas internas para compartir conocimiento y seguir creciendo.

🌍 Proyecto internacional con tecnologías de vanguardia y gran impacto en negocio.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Payment Intelligence
Description:
About Us

GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.

We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.

Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.

The role

Data sits at the core of our mission. We leverage bank account data to deliver high-value, intelligent payment solutions for our customers, from enhancing payment success rates to driving payer fraud prevention.

As a Senior Data Scientist within our Payment Intelligence team, you’ll partner with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Designers to turn big ideas into reality. You’ll own the full lifecycle of our algorithms, shaping everything from the initial concept to production-ready code that powers our global payment network.

At GoCardless, our stack is centered around Google Cloud Platform and Vertex AI, providing a high-performance environment for innovation. Our Data Scientists operate at the intersection of Python, SQL, and BigQuery to build and deploy high-performance models at scale.

What You’ll Do


Lead the end-to-end delivery of models at scale, from initial discovery and feature engineering to production, A/B testing and continuous monitoring.
Collaborate with product and engineering peers to turn complex data into real-time, mission-critical fraud prevention solutions.
Raise the team’s collective bar through hands-on technical leadership and knowledge sharing.
Proactively research and integrate latest developments in ML and payer fraud prevention to drive innovation at GoCardless.


What Excites You


Being a self-starter who thrives on taking a vague business problem and owning the journey from the first prototype to a live, measurable solution.
An opportunity to introduce and scale advanced architectures to solve high-stakes fraud and payment challenges.
Moving beyond execution to help define the technical roadmap for Payer Fraud Prevention, ensuring we leverage the best tools for the job.
Building production-grade ML models on a streamlined GCP and Vertex AI stack to drive fintech innovation.


What Excites Us


You hold a degree (or PhD) in a STEM discipline or an equivalent commercial experience.
You bring hands-on experience with sophisticated architectures, such as deep learning, graph-based, or sequence-based models (experience in Fintech, Fraud Prevention, or Payments is a big plus).
You can translate complex ML concepts into practical product solutions and communicate these ideas clearly to non-technical peers.
You are comfortable owning the full lifecycle, from deep-dive analysis and feature engineering to prototyping, validation, and live A/B testing.
You lead by example, writing clean, high-quality code and raising the team’s technical bar through knowledge sharing and code best practices.


Base salary range: €55,200 - €82,800

Please note this range is indicative. The budget for this role is flexible and will be shaped by the hiring process - we're open to discussing what's right based on the individual.

Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data. Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the minimum and the mid-point of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.

(some of) The good stuff


Wellbeing - stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover
Work away scheme - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period
Adaptive Working - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle
Parental leave - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure
Learning Budget - lead your own development with an annual learning budget
Time off - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)


Life at GoCardless

We're an organisation defined by our values; We start with why before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We act with integrity, always. We care deeply about what we do and we know it's essential that we be humble whilst we do it. Working this way creates the GC magic- the reason we all love showing up to work.

Diversity & Inclusion

As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.

To Ensure That We're Representative Of The World Around Us - And To Be Able To Review Relevant Benchmarks - We Ask GeeCees To Voluntarily Disclose Diversity Data. We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations. Check out our sustainability action plan here.

Title: Senior Data Scientist – BIP AI LAB
Description:
Entra nel nostro mondo. Trasforma insieme a noi. 

Senior Data Scientist – BIP AI LAB 

Location: Bari – Ibrido 

Quale sarà la tua sfida? 

Lavorare in BIP AI LAB significa operare in un contesto internazionale e multidisciplinare, contribuendo a progetti di consulenza, innovazione, ricerca finanziata e formazione sull’Intelligenza Artificiale. Farai parte di un team multidisciplinare che integra tre anime: 




Research: esperti che presidiano lo stato dell'arte in machine learning, AI generativa e metodi quantitativi. 




Engineering: sviluppatori e ingegneri specializzati in data engineering, data science, integrazione e visualizzazione del dato. 




Delivery: consulenti che traducono le soluzioni in risultati di business, dal design alla produzione. 




Competenze richieste 




Guidare la progettazione e lo sviluppo di soluzioni ML e Deep Learning end-to-end, dalla definizione del problema statistico al modeling fino alla valutazione e al deployment. 




Presidiare attività avanzate di feature engineering, model selection e hyperparameter tuning su dataset complessi e di grandi dimensioni. 




Definire e condurre analisi statistiche avanzate (modelli bayesiani, causal inference, experimental design) a supporto di decisioni strategiche dei clienti. 




Collaborare con AI Engineer e MLOps nella produttizzazione dei modelli, assicurando qualità, riproducibilità e monitorabilità. 




Contribuire alla definizione di framework metodologici e linee guida di Responsible & Explainable AI applicati ai progetti. 




Fare mentoring tecnico e scientifico verso i profili più junior, attraverso code review, knowledge sharing e affiancamento su progetti. 




Requisiti principali 




Da 3 a 6 anni di esperienza in ruoli di Data Scientist o ML Researcher, preferibilmente in contesti consulenziali o industriali. 




Padronanza avanzata di Python e del suo ecosistema DS/ML (scikit-learn, PyTorch o TensorFlow, statsmodels). 




Solide basi in statistica (inferenza, modelli lineari, bayesian inference) e nei principali paradigmi di ML/DL supervisionato e non supervisionato. 




Esperienza dimostrabile nel portare modelli in produzione e nell’integrazione con pipeline MLOps. 





Capacità di tradurre problemi di business complessi in formulazioni statistiche rigorose e di comunicarne i risultati a stakeholder tecnici e non. 




Costituiscono un plus 




Esperienza specialistica in time series forecasting, NLP, computer vision o recommender systems a livello production-grade. 




Pubblicazioni scientifiche, contributi open-source o speaker in conferenze di settore. 




Certificazioni cloud ML (Azure AI Engineer, AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer). 




Sarai tu ad entrare nel nostro Team? 

Perché Bip? 

Crescita e Formazione 

Più di 300 corsi su tecnologie e business emergenti, programmi di sviluppo personalizzati e iniziative di training e people care per supportare la tua crescita professionale e personale. 

Flessibilità e Work-Life Integration 

Lavoro agile con possibilità di programmare le giornate da remoto e in ufficio con il proprio responsabile e in base alle esigenze di progetto, Banca Ore Solidale per usufruire o mettere a disposizione ore di permesso a colleghi e colleghe che vivono momenti di difficoltà e una cultura che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita e lavoro. 

Salute & Benefits 

Assicurazione sanitaria, check-up agevolati, piattaforme per il benessere psicofisico e un piano welfare integrativo. Ticket restaurant e altri benefit dedicati. 

Famiglia e Genitorialità 

Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda. 

Inclusione e Valori 

Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99). 

Cosa offriamo? 

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra € 34.000 e € 48.000 lordi annui, in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato. 

L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria 

La retribuzione indicata si riferisce alla sola RAL (Retribuzione Annua Lorda). 

Il pacchetto complessivo può includere ulteriori componenti variabili, correlate al raggiungimento di specifici obiettivi individuali e/o aziendali, welfare e benefit aziendali. La proposta economica finale sarà definita in base alle caratteristiche del profilo selezionato e alla coerenza con i requisiti della posizione. 

Next Steps 

Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente. 

Se c’è un match con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca. 

L’iter di selezione comprende generalmente un colloquio con HR, un colloquio tecnico con un line manager ed un eventuale colloquio con un Partner. 

L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di recruiting. 

In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro database per poterlo rivalutare per altre opportunità future. 

Se dovessi identificare ulteriori posizioni di tuo interesse ed in linea con il tuo profilo, aspettiamo la tua candidatura per poterla valutare nuovamente. 

Su di Noi 

Nata nel 2003, BIP è una società di consulenza internazionale focalizzata sulla trasformazione del business e sull’innovazione digitale. Oggi è presente con uffici in 14 Paesi, supporta clienti in oltre 40 Paesi e conta più di 6.000 professionisti, oltre 5.000 progetti realizzati e 1.500 clienti nel mondo. 

BIP integra competenze trasversali in ambito Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4.0, IoT e tecnologie emergenti, combinando consulenza, competenze tecnologiche e capacità di realizzazione end-to-end. 

BIP AI LAB è la nuova società del gruppo nata nel 2024 dedicata alla progettazione e all’industrializzazione di processi e soluzioni di tecnologia avanzata e Intelligenza Artificiale. Il laboratorio riunisce competenze di Research, Engineering e Delivery per trasformare la ricerca e l’innovazione in soluzioni applicabili ai processi e ai contesti aziendali. BIP AI LAB è parte attiva dell'ecosistema territoriale dell'innovazione, dove università, centri di ricerca e imprese collaborano sull'intelligenza artificiale per generare valore economico e competenze locali. 

In un contesto tecnologico e di mercato in rapida e continua evoluzione, la formazione rappresenta un benefit strategico a valore aggiunto, in grado di colmare il gap fra le esigenze aziendali e la sfida nel raggiungimento di soft skill e competenze specifiche sempre più attuali.

Title: Senior Data Scientist, Central Data Products
Description:
Change the way the world travels

Be part of the GetYourGuide journey and connect people with unforgettable travel experiences worldwide. Since 2009, millions of travelers have booked unique activities with us in over 12,000 cities. Our headquarters in Berlin is supported by 16 other local offices across the globe.

Ready to join a diverse community of over 850 fellow explorers dedicated to revolutionizing the travel experience industry? Check out our careers site to learn more.

Team mission

At the Central Data Products team, our mission is to build, operate, and drive adoption of horizontal data products that empower multiple clusters across GetYourGuide.

We are a horizontal team within central services, and our products are pivotal to the entire flywheel: Consumer, Growth, and Supply. We own the systems that decide how our marketplace is understood and organized: location and travel category tagging that powers landing pages, the landing page eligibility framework that unlocks marketing efficiency at scale, destination maps and travel-relevance models that steer supply acquisition into untapped markets, and the Customer Lifetime Value model that shifts the company from short-term revenue optimization to long-term customer value. Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Tech that takes you places




We’re CarTrawler, the global travel tech company behind seamless connections between people, places and possibilities. From powering car rental to creating smarter ways to move, we make travel smoother for millions worldwide. Our culture is built on curiosity, collaboration and craic where every idea counts and every journey matters. Ready to make an impact? Let’s go places together.




Were looking for someone who enjoys;

Solving complex real-world business problems using cutting-edge machine learning methods and techniques.
Developing data-driven models and tools to optimise trading performance across a host of domains including pricing and recommended sort.
Conducting exploratory analysis to generate actionable insights, identify opportunities, and enhance our understanding of consumer behaviours.




What you'll do as a Data Scientist:

Develop industry leading data science solutions through:
Define data requirements and extracting required data to support solution development.
Perform exploratory data analysis to improve understanding of underlying trends and behaviours to help inform feature engineering work and next steps in modelling process.
Support in the designing and development of scalable and efficient data driven solutions.
Input into the design decisions determining optimal data science methodologies and technologies to use to solve the problem at hand.
Ensure integrity of the data science solutions in terms of the underlying statistical and economic models and assumptions.
Collaborate with the MLOps team in the development and deployment of proposed solutions to a live environment and tracking the effects in real time.
Devise statistically robust testing plans to validate effectiveness of solutions.
Collate results from in-market tests and validating them.
Effectively communicate outputs of work to other team members and business stakeholders in a manner that can be understood by both technical and non-technical audiences.
Work with colleagues in Revenue function to ensure they are equipped with required tools, models and resources for optimising trading performance.
Support the wider business with BAU tasks related to the services Data Science provide or with designing new data-driven solutions to solve their complex business problems.
Proactively work with wider data & technology teams to support the collection of new data and refinement of existing data sources.




Knowledge and Skills:

Undergraduate, M.S. or Ph.D. in a relevant quantitative field, and 3+ years’ experience in a relevant role.
Solid understanding of statistical modelling, algorithms, data mining and machine learning workflows.
Some experience or knowledge of using more advanced ML libraries (TensorFlow, PyTorch, MXnet, etc.).
Experience in the development or application of GenAI algorithms seen as a plus.
Proficient in writing well structured, robust and readable code in Python.
Proficient in SQL and relevant experience using relational databases.
Ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner.
Proven experience manipulating and analysing complex, high-volume, high-dimensional data from varying sources.
Ability to create compelling visualisations and dashboards (e.g. Tableau, Thoughtspot).
Knowledge of Git and modern development workflows.
Proven ability to work creatively and analytically in a fast-paced, problem-solving environment.
Ability to partner with Software Engineering teams to co-develop functionality for the business.

Title: (Senior) Data Scientist (all genders)
Description:
At flaconi, we believe that diversity fuels creativity, innovation and growth. It thrives in all its forms of beauty. Our team is a mosaic of individuals from different backgrounds, cultures and life journeys, all united by a shared passion for beauty. Our commitment is grounded in our core values, particularly #trustinpeople. We hold ourselves accountable for creating an environment where every employee feels honestly valued, heard and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives to foster belonging.

flaconi is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes and encourages all qualified from all backgrounds and identities, regardless of ethnicity, race, gender identity, migration background, national origin, disability status, sexual orientation, religion, or age to apply.

If you require specific support during the application or interview process – e.g. live captions, more time for the interview or the task in a different format – just let us know so that we can adapt the process accordingly. We will do our best to make this possible.

We are seeking a (Senior) Data Scientist (all genders) to join a dynamic team of six within our DATA department. You'll dive into diverse challenges including training and deploying machine learning models, developing Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions, and statistical modeling. We believe in flat hierarchies, which means you'll work closely with colleagues of various seniorities in a fun environment. You'll play a key role in extracting valuable insights and developing data and AI solutions to optimize our e-commerce platform across Europe, taking end-to-end ownership of your projects and collaborating closely with business stakeholders along the way. Your contributions will have a direct impact on business decisions and process efficiency across a wide spectrum of unique use cases.

Your Role




Employ statistical techniques and machine learning algorithms for regression, classification, and clustering (e.g., Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, Hierarchical Clustering, ensemble methods).
Develop and productionalize Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions alongside modern NLP techniques using transformer architectures (e.g., BERT, GPT).
Utilize time-series forecasting methods (e.g., ARIMA, LSTM, DeepAR, Prophet) for predictive modeling.
Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA), advanced feature engineering, and dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE).
Develop and implement deep learning models in PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Keras while leveraging transfer learning strategies.
Showcase your skills across key e-commerce data science use cases including demand forecasting, churn and CLTV modeling, pricing, customer segmentation, recommender systems, and personalization.
Handle large-scale datasets using distributed computing frameworks (Apache Spark) on a tech stack comprising Python (PySpark, pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, LightGBM), SQL, Databricks (Data Lakehouse & ML platform), AWS (S3, Lambda, EC2, SageMaker, Bedrock), GitHub, and AI-augmented tools (Claude, Copilot) while collaborating directly to proactively address stakeholder business needs.


Your Profile




Bring a minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience in developing and deploying machine learning solutions for real-world business problems.
Demonstrate background exposure to e-commerce (ideal), fintech, or fast-paced agency environments.
Demonstrate hands-on experience with Databricks as a Data & AI platform (required) alongside cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Prove hands-on experience in building, productionalizing, and deploying Generative AI or Agentic AI solutions.
Apply hands-on experience with MLOps practices and tools (required) for end-to-end model lifecycle management.
Possess a strong grasp of core data science principles to select the most appropriate techniques, combined with advanced proficiency in SQL, Python (PySpark, scikit-learn, NumPy, matplotlib, pandas), and AI-augmented development tools (Claude, Copilot).
Communicate exceptionally in English (written and verbal) to articulate complex concepts to non-technical stakeholders, driving projects with full end-to-end ownership as a collaborative team player.


What We Offer


Our employees matter to us: We offer you a permanent contract and cover the costs for your Deutschland ticket.
Work-life balance: 29 vacation days plus additional days off on the 24th and 31st December, flexible working hours, up to three days of working from home per week, working abroad options, paid sabbatical.
flaconi Academy: Actively shape your own career path by taking advantage of our internal and external training opportunities.
We care about your well being: We want to support you also during difficult times. For this, we offer you and your close relatives counseling sessions with mental health professionals.
flaconi fitness: a wide range of sports options & discounts on memberships.
Family first: Our “emergency-daycare” is there for you in out-of-the-ordinary situations to look after your child on site at our office.
Thinking about tomorrow together: flaconi subsidizes your savings contribution to the company pension scheme with an additional 20%.
A comfortable working space with everything you need: High end technical equipment, fruits and drinks, no dress code and dogs are welcome in our office!
Other perks: Great discounts in our online shop as well with our partner companies, cool team events & company parties!


Check out all benefits HERE.

Founded in 2011 as one of the first online perfumeries, flaconi is honored to work with more than 700 people from 60 different nations at the flaconi headquarters in Berlin-Charlottenburg and its fulfillment center in Halle. Shape our company’s success with us and apply now online! We look forward to receiving your complete application documents including your earliest starting date and salary expectations.flaconi will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source (e.g. recruitment agency) other than directly from a candidate.

AI Notice

We use AI-powered tools to streamline and support individual steps in our recruiting process. For example, these tools help our recruiting team identify suitable candidates, prioritize applications, and gain insights relevant to recruiting. The AI does not make any hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed and evaluated by people, and all hiring decisions are made under human supervision and responsibility. Our AI system is regularly reviewed for potential biases and holds ISO 42001 certification for AI governance. If you have any questions about our use of AI or would like an explanation of the criteria, please feel free to contact our Talent Acquisition team at jobs@flaconi.de at any time.

The offered salary will always be within this range and is based on the outcomes of the recruitment process.

Salary range (annual brutto): €60.000 EUR - €80.000 EUR
